rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is enough or adequate.

example.english: Is this money sufficient to buy a ticket?
example.traditional: 呢啲錢夠唔夠買張飛呀？
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 cin2 gau3 m4 gau3 maai5 zoeng1 fei1 aa3

rows.note: Use this when you want to state explicitly that the amount or level is sufficient.

example.english: We have sufficient time to finish the report.
example.traditional: 我哋有足夠時間完成份報告。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jau5 zuk1 gau3 si4 gaan3 jyun4 sing4 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this mainly for formal or technical contexts such as a sufficient condition or sufficient preparation.

example.english: The company has made sufficient preparations for this audit.
example.traditional: 公司已經作好充分準備，應付今次審查。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 zok3 hou2 cung1 fan6 zeon2 bei6 jing1 fu6 gam1 ci3 sam2 caa4
